name: Late shipment worklist
prompt: Late shipment worklist: a table of the most delayed delivered shipments with carrier, supplier and region, plus late rate by carrier.

binding.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_delivered_count
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE status = 'delivered'
  AND is_late = TRUE
  AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)

copy.title: Late deliveries count
copy.caption: 42 shipments were delivered late in the selected date range.

binding.sql:
WITH delivered_shipments AS (
  SELECT
    shipment_id,
    carrier,
    supplier,
    region,
    dispatched,
    promised,
    delivered,
    delay_days,
    order_value,
    is_late
  FROM shipment_performance
  WHERE status = 'delivered'
    AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
    AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
),
carrier_rates AS (
  SELECT
    carrier,
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS carrier_late_rate_pct
  FROM delivered_shipments
  GROUP BY carrier
)
SELECT
  d.shipment_id AS shipment_id,
  d.carrier AS carrier,
  d.supplier AS supplier,
  d.region AS region,
  d.dispatched AS dispatched,
  d.promised AS promised,
  d.delivered AS delivered,
  d.delay_days AS delay_days,
  ROUND(d.order_value, 2) AS order_value,
  c.carrier_late_rate_pct AS carrier_late_rate_pct
FROM delivered_shipments d
JOIN carrier_rates c USING (carrier)
WHERE d.is_late = TRUE
ORDER BY d.delay_days DESC, d.order_value DESC, d.delivered DESC
LIMIT 50

copy.title: Most delayed delivered shipments
copy.caption: Delayed deliveries are clustered in Europe and all top delays come from DB Schenker, running 7–9 days late.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  carrier AS carrier,
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS late_rate
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE status = 'delivered'
  AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY carrier
ORDER BY late_rate DESC, carrier
LIMIT 10

copy.title: Late rate by carrier
copy.caption: DB Schenker has the highest late rate at 79.2%, while DHL and FedEx show none.
